name: state
meaning: 0 armed/waiting for the Wolf, 1 falling, 2 landed (camera hold), 3 finished. Set to 3 at init when the ACTIVATIONBOX property is missing.

name: camRecord
meaning: PROPERTY_FALLINGROCK_CAMERA (4): the camera setup {u16 focal; u16 rot[3]; Vec3s pos} used for the scripted shot. NULL means no cutaway.

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY_FALLINGROCK_ACTIVATIONBOX (0). Triggers on the Wolf's x and z only — the vertical pair (+6/+0xc) is never tested. NULL disables the rock.

name: camHoldMs
meaning: How long the scripted camera is held after landing. Hard-coded to 500 at 0x4bb16c; the designers' PROPERTY_TIMERCAMERA (8) is never read by the class. Unsigned compare (jbe) at 0x4bb358.

name: camElapsedMs
meaning: Milliseconds accumulated (g_dtMs) since the rock landed, compared against camHoldMs to end the shot.

name: fallTicksLeft
meaning: Remaining descent steps. Init 5; each Update tick in state 1 translates 400 units DOWN, undoing exactly the 2000-unit lift. name: impactSoundHandle
meaning: Sound_Play handle for the impact sound (id 0x44). Zeroed at init and stored on landing, but never read anywhere in the class (exactly 2 references), so the rock can neither stop nor re-query the voice.
